guardrails._cooldown_help: Applies only between DIFFERENT bot teams: a bot cannot make a free-agent add/drop within N minutes of another bot team's add/drop (checked against ESPN's activity feed). The same team may make several add/drops or waiver claims back to back. Waiver claim submissions and lineup/IR moves are exempt.

_drop_overrides_help: Map player_id -> reason to allow dropping a protected player. The reason is logged.
_assist_help: Assist teams get suggestions only: lineup alerts and up to 2 waiver ideas. Nothing is auto-executed and nothing goes to approve.py; the team's own manager decides. Assist output is never read by bots, and team 5's suggestions stay in my_team/.

execution.help: Moves use LM tools from the commissioner login (SWID/ESPN_S2). Waiver claims are submitted as the team owner (normal priority). Per-team manager cookies (SWID_TEAM_<id>/ESPN_S2_TEAM_<id>) are optional and unused.
